verdict.rationale: Unity documents launching the Editor from the command line with arguments to automate workflows (docs-6, docs-7), and its -batchmode/-nographics CLI is documented for headless CI builds (probe-rt-3). The standalone Unity CLI targets CI and build agents for installing editors (docs-25, docs-26), and Unity Build Automation provides hosted CI multiplatform builds (docs-28, docs-36). missing for 10: quoted docs for the specific build/export invocation (e.g. build-target or execute-method flags), independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI builds.
